---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you're running into (e.g., "when planning across a zone boundary I have to ...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Which part of the package would this affect?**

- [ ] Data layer (`MapData`, parsing, serialization, Overpass)
- [ ] Path planning (`GraphPlanner`, Grid A\*, RRT\*, `ReplanPath`)
- [ ] Interactive viewer (Flask/Leaflet frontend or REST API)
- [ ] ROS2 nodes (`osm_cloud`, tracker)
- [ ] CLI tools (`create_mapdata`, `map_data_info`, `map_data_viewer`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other / not sure

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or example map data here. If the request relates to
specific OSM features or tags, include the tag values involved.
